description: This file defines a Highlight class used for visual highlighting of DOM elements, including tooltips and overlays, in a web page context. It manages DOM elements, styles, and animations for highlighting purposes within a testing or debugging environment.

classes.name: Highlight
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering visual highlights and tooltips on DOM elements, managing highlight overlays, and handling user interactions for debugging or testing purposes.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Highlight instance, creates overlay DOM elements, and sets up styles and event listeners.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Appends the highlight overlay to the document if not already present.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets the scripting language used for locator generation.

methods.name: runHighlightOnRaf
methods.description: Highlights elements matching a selector, using requestAnimationFrame for smooth updates.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Removes the highlight overlay from the document.

methods.name: showActionPoint
methods.description: Displays an action point indicator at specified coordinates.

methods.name: clearHighlight
methods.description: Removes all current highlights and tooltips.

methods.name: maskElements
methods.description: Highlights given elements with a specified color.

methods.name: updateHighlight
methods.description: Updates the visual highlight overlays based on provided entries.

methods.name: firstBox
methods.description: Returns the bounding box of the first highlighted element.

methods.name: tooltipPosition
methods.description: Calculates optimal position for tooltips relative to target boxes.

methods.name: _highlightIsUpToDate
methods.description: Checks if the current highlights match the previous state to avoid unnecessary re-rendering.

methods.name: _createHighlightElement
methods.description: Creates a new highlight DOM element.

methods.name: appendChild
methods.description: Appends a DOM element to the highlight overlay.
